meta.name: fvs_feature_config_v2
meta.description: Feature clusters for predicting downstream impact from a cleaned theorem dependency DAG. Features respect the (d,r) horizon: for r=0 use only seen graph (depth<=d or <d, configurable); for r>=1 allow peek into future via full G_dag neighborhood of v.

node_basic.description: Intrinsic node properties available at prediction time (no future info).

parents_degree_stats.description: Statistics of parents within the seen graph.

parents_forward_reach_seen.description: Forward reachability proxies for parents, computed inside seen graph only (no leakage beyond horizon).

parents_ancestry_overlap.description: How similar parents are in upstream lineage (overlap of ancestor sets) inside seen graph only.

parentset_structure.description: Higher-order statistics of the parent set (co-occurrence, novelty, recombination).

lineage_fertility.description: How 'fertile' the parents are at the next depth step in the seen graph.

upstream_nonlocal.description: Upstream structure beyond immediate parents (still upstream, but not local).

mixture_diversity.description: How many distinct upstream components/modules the parents pull from.

peek_r1.description: r=1 peek: immediate children in the full DAG (one-step future).

peek_r2.description: r=2 peek: grandchildren in the full DAG (two-step future).
